content.title: THE MINERAL BEHIND YOUR {{THYROID}} NO ONE CHECKS
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Seaweed | Cod | Shrimp | Dairy Milk | Eggs
**Copper** (Energy Enzyme Helper) — Oysters | Cashew Butter | Mushrooms | Dark Leafy Greens
**Manganese** (Bone & Joint Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple Core | Brown Rice | Chickpeas
**Selenium** (Immune Shield) — Brazil Nuts (just 2/day) | Tuna | Turkey | Sunflower Seeds
**Potassium** (Blood Pressure Balancer) — Sweet Potatoes | Coconut Water | Swiss Chard | White Beans
**Zinc** (Wound Healer) — Pumpkin Seeds | Crab | Chickpeas | Beef
**Follow along** – for more mineral breakdowns most people never learn.
content.caption:
Your thyroid runs almost entirely on iodine — without enough of it, your metabolism can slow down even if you're eating perfectly otherwise. Just 2 Brazil nuts a day can cover your daily selenium needs, which your body uses to protect cells from oxidative stress and support that same thyroid function. And copper doesn't get much attention, but it's essential for forming red blood cells and keeping your energy enzymes actually working — a quiet deficiency here can leave you feeling drained for no obvious reason. Everyone's body absorbs minerals differently, so listen to yours.

This is what @smarthealthfix is all about — breaking down nutrition, common health issues, organ function, and small daily habits into things you can actually use. Our mission is to help you understand your body a little better, one post at a time.
